manual.turntable.line2: {0}The Turntable will rotate blocks placed against its front side through various angles.{1}
manual.turntable.line3: Holding an Engineer's Hammer while looking at a side of the machine displays its rotating side and the turn direction associated with the targeted side.{0}
manual.turntable.line4: The turn direction is set individually for each of the 4 sides around the turning axis, allowing for ±90° or 180° turns, depending on which side receives the redstone signal.{0}
manual.turntable.line5: Rightclicking with the Hammer will reorient it, sneaking while doing so will cycle through the Turntable's turn directions.
